question: Welcher Aufgabenbereich hat seinen Anteil von 10,2% im inneren Kreis auf 7,8% im äußeren Kreis reduziert?
question_english: Which task area reduced its share from 10.2% in the inner ring to 7.8% in the outer ring?
model_answer: According to the figure, the **Abfallwirtschaft (Waste Management)** sector experienced a reduction in its share, decreasing from 10.2% in the inner circle (2014) to 7.8% in the outer circle (2021). This indicates a smaller proportion of resources allocated to waste management over that period.
